name: What is the best paint finish for kitchen walls?

mainEntity.name: What is the best paint finish for kitchen walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best paint finish for kitchen walls is typically satin or semi-gloss. Kitchens experience grease, steam, and frequent cleaning, which can degrade flat or matte finishes. Satin offers a soft sheen that resists moisture and wipes clean easily, making it the standard choice for general wall areas. Semi-gloss is harder, shinier, and more water-resistant, making it ideal for high-splatter zones near sinks, ranges, and on trim or baseboards. If your kitchen walls have noticeable surface imperfections or older drywall patches, satin does a better job concealing them than higher-gloss sheens.
acceptedAnswer.description: Satin and semi-gloss are best for kitchen walls. Satin works well on general wall areas, while semi-gloss provides maximum moisture and grease resistance for high-splatter zones and trim.
